scenario_type: Compromised Admin + Defense Evasion + Backup Tampering + Encryption Staging
investigation_objective: Determine whether suspicious administrative activity across file servers represents approved maintenance or active ransomware pre-staging requiring immediate escalation and containment.

likely_adversary_objective.summary: Prepare for broad ransomware encryption by disabling defenses, impairing recovery, staging payloads, and testing file rename behavior.

alerts.title: Mass Shadow Copy Deletion
alerts.description: Shadow copies were deleted on a production file server using vssadmin.exe.
alerts.why_it_matters: Deleting shadow copies is a common ransomware preparation step that limits recovery options.

alerts.title: EDR Protection Disabled
alerts.description: Endpoint protection services were stopped on a production file server.
evidence: Service account is not expected to disable security tooling
alerts.why_it_matters: Disabling EDR before file-system activity is a strong ransomware pre-staging indicator.

alerts.title: Backup Job Deletion Attempt
alerts.description: User attempted to delete or disable backup jobs for production file servers.
evidence: Retention policy modified from 30 days to 1 day
No approved backup change ticket found
alerts.why_it_matters: Backup tampering before destructive activity can reduce recovery options and increase ransomware impact.

alerts.title: Suspicious Encryption Tool Staged
alerts.description: Unsigned executable with high-entropy packed characteristics was staged in a temporary directory.
evidence: File copied to multiple file servers over ADMIN$
alerts.why_it_matters: Staging suspicious binaries across file servers before encryption behavior is consistent with ransomware deployment.

alerts.title: SMB Fanout to File Servers
alerts.description: The service account initiated SMB sessions to multiple production file servers within a short window.
evidence: File copy activity observed over administrative shares
alerts.why_it_matters: Rapid SMB fanout with file copy activity can indicate ransomware staging across target systems.

alerts.title: Mass File Rename Test Pattern
alerts.description: A burst of file rename activity appended a new extension to files in a limited directory set.
evidence: Activity occurred in FinanceArchive test subfolder
Rename pattern stopped after EDR alert
alerts.why_it_matters: Small-scale file rename or encryption tests often precede broader ransomware deployment.

alerts.title: External RDP Login to Admin Jump Host
alerts.description: Backup service account authenticated interactively to an admin jump host from an unusual VPN source.
evidence: Service account normally uses non-interactive backup APIs
alerts.why_it_matters: Interactive use of a service account from unusual infrastructure is consistent with credential compromise.

threat_context.threat_summary: The observed sequence strongly matches ransomware pre-staging: service account misuse, EDR disablement, shadow copy deletion, backup tampering, suspicious binary staging, SMB fanout, and mass rename testing.

observed_evidence: Interactive RDP login using privileged backup service account

mitre_attack_mapping.technique_name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools
observed_evidence: EDR protection service stopped on FS-SRV-14
Backup retention and repository protections modified
Executable copied over ADMIN$ to multiple production file servers
Mass file rename test pattern appended .locked-test extension

detection_recommendation.detection_goal: Detect ransomware pre-staging by correlating EDR disablement, shadow copy deletion, backup tampering, SMB fanout, suspicious binary staging, and mass file rename behavior within a short window.
tuning_recommendations: Raise severity when shadow copy deletion and EDR disablement occur within 30 minutes.
Do not suppress when backup tampering and shadow deletion occur together.
